LightningComponentBundle.description: Uploads public images to AWS S3 bucket

property.name: imageMaxWidth
property.label: Image max width
property.description: Enter max image width in pixels

property.name: imageMaxHeight
property.label: Image max Height
property.description: Enter max image height in pixels

property.name: imageMode
property.label: Image sizing mode (crop or resize)
property.description: Crop = trims excess image data and fits in dimensions, resize = fits whole image within bounds

property.name: fileNameSuffix
property.label: File name suffix
property.description: This will be applied to the end of image file name saved in s3 making the file name unique

property.name: imageField
property.label: Image Field API
property.description: Enter the field API name of the field on the object your image URL will be recorded

property.name: incomingRecordId
property.label: Incoming record Id
property.description: The variable id of the record for which to attach this image
